text:
Asking rents in Erfurt stand at a median of 10.00 €/m² (2026-06), up 6.7% on the year and +26.6% over five years. That ranks Erfurt #23 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 54% above the 2022 average contract rent of 6.48 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 600 € a month in cold rent, 14.2% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 29 days and 24% are gone within a week; with 2.5% market-active vacancy and +0.9% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 10.41 €/m² (+4.2%), with an 80% range of 10.02 to 10.71 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
